crossRefs.note: She said, “Who would have said to Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? For I have borne him a son in his old age.”
When she had weaned him, she took him up with her, with three bulls, and one ephah of meal, and a container of wine…

people.name: Genubath
people.line: Son of Hadad the Edomite; raised in Pharaoh's palace.

people.name: Tahpenes
people.line: Egyptian queen who raised Hadad the Edomite

translations.web: The sister of Tahpenes bore him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh’s house; and Genubath was in Pharaoh’s house among the sons of Pharaoh.
translations.bsb: And the sister of Tahpenes bore Hadad a son named Genubath. Tahpenes herself weaned him in Pharaoh’s palace, and Genubath lived there among the sons of Pharaoh.
translations.kjv: And the sister of Tahpenes bare him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh's house: and Genubath was in Pharaoh's household among the sons of Pharaoh.
translations.asv: And the sister of Tahpenes bare him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh's house; and Genubath was in Pharaoh's house among the sons of Pharaoh.
